richiami.difetto: On affected models the starter relay connector can overheat and melt which prevents the battery charging
richiami.rimedio: Modify the wiring to the starter relay.

richiami.difetto: On affected motorcycles the T-box rubber support ring could break allowing the T-Box to drop into a position that could affect the steering.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the T-box rubber support ring with a modified design and add a T-box holder.

richiami.difetto: On affected motorcycles the ABS control module may require excessive braking effort because of the software settings. When the ABS is activated and the rider double applies the hand brake lever in quick succession it will result in the braking distance increasing.�
richiami.rimedio: Install updated software to the ABS control module.�
richiami.titolo: On affected motorcycles the ABS control module may require excessive braking effort because of the software settings. When the ABS is activated and the rider double applies the hand brake lever in quick succession it will result in the braking distance increasing.
